to_json(t).title: Know what the site needs to do.
to_json(t).body: Start with the job, the audience, and the constraints. Then choose the right build.

to_json(t).title: Make the invisible parts dependable.
to_json(t).body: Forms, data, consent, redirects, accessibility, and performance get the same checks as the page.

to_json(t).title: Leave the team in a better position.
to_json(t).body: Build for the next edit, the next campaign, and the person who has to maintain it.
